title: Rarely Optimized
description: Rarely Optimized is the performance focused Minecraft optimization mod pack.
body:
Rarely-Optimized - Lightweight Optimization Modpack

Rarely-Optimized is a lightweight, client-side Fabric optimization modpack designed to significantly improve FPS, reduce lag, and provide a smooth Minecraft experience without changing vanilla gameplay.

This modpack focuses on performance, stability, and configurability while keeping the game visually clean and shader-ready.

🚀 Features

Major FPS boost using modern optimization mods

Reduced CPU & RAM usage

Faster chunk loading and smoother gameplay

Shader support with Iris

Fully client-side (works on any server)

Vanilla-friendly, no gameplay changes

🧩 Included Mods

Sodium, Sodium Extra & Reese’s Sodium Options

Iris Shaders

FerriteCore & ModernFix

Entity Culling & More Culling

ImmediatelyFast & Dynamic FPS

Mod Menu & Cloth Config API

Krypton, Exordium, ScalableLux

Mouse Tweaks, Zoomify, Dynamic Lights

Crash Assistant

🖥️ Compatibility

Loader: Fabric

Environment: Client-side only

Works with: Singleplayer & Multiplayer

Shader Support: Yes (via Iris)

⚠️ Notes

This modpack does not need to be installed on the server

Some mods may use different versions for stability

Designed for low-end to mid-range PCs, but works great on high-end systems too

📌 Goal

Vanilla Minecraft, but faster, smoother, and more stable.
